about: rqgm_check.py selftest: each case runs 'audit' on one fixture and must match exactly. codes = [code, class] multiset of all findings; [] = no findings of any class. Cases with a source field are archives from runs/2026-09-25-peer/checker-attack/ (copied verbatim, then migrated to the v3.1 SKILL.md Memory schema: every v3 fixture's check records gained models (the setup's judge models) and each held-out pass map became results over the required criteria (false -> fail); a migrated field names any further rewrite); ruling says whether the checker was changed for them or the break was ruled not a checker defect. Every v3 fixture was then migrated to the 8332bed570f1 schema (SKILL.md Memory: criteria[].files, gates.retries, citation.version, heldout.results{id:{value,votes}}; judges rate "each criterion and must_not_change id"): a command criterion gained files (setup.check_files, else tests/test_<id>.py), each gates object gained retries (1 after an ERROR, else 0), each completed verdict rates every DONE criterion and must_not_change id it left unrated as tie, each citation gained version (the best it was logged under; null for a gap's evidence), each Check logging a source criterion pass gained one verified citation for that criterion and version just before it, and each bare held-out mark became {value, votes} (three equal votes; unchecked: an ERROR vote). record_indexes follow the inserted lines.

screen UNKNOWN is never a pass ("UNKNOWN is never a tie, pass or support"): the Screen did not pass, so the keep is GATE_KEPT
screen "Rejected: rubric echo": values match case-insensitively, and any screen result but pass rejects
c1 "FAIL" while best passes c1: case-insensitive, so REGRESSION_KEPT
c1 logged as exit status 1 while best passes c1: a nonzero exit status fails (0 passes), so REGRESSION_KEPT
apply "applied" is not ok: a diff not shown to apply is an ERROR (dropped), so the keep is GATE_KEPT; the gate no longer returns unauditable before the commands and Screen
gates.verifier ERROR after its one retry: the variant is dropped ("Retry an ERROR once (retries), then drop its variant"), so the keep is GATE_KEPT
v3 gates with no verifier (gates:{apply,commands,verifier,screen}): RECORD_MISSING like fn09's missing screen, and the keep is not credited
every judge ERROR logs retries 0: "Retry an ERROR once (retries), then drop its variant", so each drop without its retry is RETRY_MISSING
slot 2 rates protected c2 "Best": verdict values match case-insensitively, so KEEP_VETOED
judge 1 overall "Best" with high confidence: read as best, so the early rejection applies and the keep is KEEP_VETOED
judge 3 logged slot "3" (a string) and preferred best: slot "3" is slot 3, so KEEP_VETOED (an extra verdict never supports but still objects)
must_not_change as [{id,text}]: its ids are protected like the {id:text} map, so slot 2 rating m1 worse is KEEP_VETOED

the probe seeded its defect against c1, a command criterion ("seeded with one judges-criterion defect"): normal mode is unproven, so the rung is strict (PROBE_MODE_WRONG) and the 2/2 keep is STRICT_KEEP
unified-diff strings: a string is one opaque edit compared verbatim (KEPT_TEXT_MISMATCH) and its ---/+++ headers name the files it edits (CHECK_FILE_EDIT on tests/test_public.py)
the applied version names check file tests/test_public.py that the judged diff did not: check files are read from the version diff too

no setup.check_files; DONE c1 lists files [tests/test_public.py] ("listing every file it runs: its check files"): a criterion's files are check files. On v3 a command criterion without files is RECORD_MISSING (p16_command_files_missing); command strings are not parsed, since a command may name TARGET files it only checks
variant.words 90 but the applied version logs 120: "apply exactly the judged text", so KEPT_TEXT_MISMATCH
an edit whose new text equals its old text changes nothing, like fn27's empty diff: the keep is KEEP_WITHOUT_SUPPORT
a second parentless version before round 1 replaces best with unjudged text: only v0 may be a root, so VERSION_WITHOUT_KEEP
c3 pass with votes null: absent or empty votes are RECORD_MISSING on a v3 archive and the pass is not credited
votes logged as {judge: vote}: its values are counted, so 1 pass of 3 logged pass is CHECK_MISCOUNT
DONE kinds "Command"/"Judges" match case-insensitively: c1 is required at the gate (RECORD_MISSING for commands {}) and c3's 1/3 votes are CHECK_MISCOUNT

v3 DONE criteria with no kind ({id,required,kind,guardrail?}): RECORD_MISSING at setup; a pass on a criterion of unknown kind is not credited, and the probe's seeded criterion is not a known judges criterion, so the rung is strict

a required open gap re-logged required:false with no amend stays required: since v3.1 a gap is required unless DONE makes its criterion optional, and a gap naming no criterion is required (fail closed)
the kept diff writes an [OPEN] into best and no substrate record logs it ("Log the round, any version and substrate"): an unlogged [OPEN] counts as a required open gap (fail closed)
attempt 1 on set "spares" (the prose word): read as the spare set, so HELDOUT_REROLL
attempt 2 reruns set "Primary": case-insensitive, so HELDOUT_REROLL
attempt 2 with no set (heldout{attempt,set,version,pass}): RECORD_MISSING, and the pass is not credited (only the spares may run as attempt 2)
exit status "Complete" is COMPLETE: no held-out run, so FALSE_COMPLETE
record types match case-insensitively: {"t":"Setup"} is the setup record, so the COMPLETE with no held-out run is FALSE_COMPLETE
setup logged after the round: an archive is v3 from its first line (RECORD_MISSING for the round's missing screen), and a late setup is SETUP_LATE (RECORD)

cases.note: setup.loop "V3" is v3 (case-insensitive): fn08/fn09's gaps are RECORD_MISSING again
{"t":"Round"} is a round record, so 4 rounds under a 2-round budget are BUDGET_OVERRUN twice
a line repeating a key ({"t":"round",...,"t":"note"}) is ambiguous: which value counts depends on the parser, so it is an integrity error (exit 2) and nothing after it is audited
v2 variant records inside a v3 archive hide rounds from the budget: each is RECORD_MISSING (a v3 round record)
rung E1 after E2 is not an escalation (E1 < E2 < E3): like fn11's repeated rung it neither resets the stall count nor settles the due Check, so MISSED_CHECK; E2 again is then a repeat
after HALT(ERROR) and a resume, rounds 3-5 are all-ERROR: two or more in a row keep HALT(ERROR) due (the streak test was == 2), so rounds 4, 5 and the HUMAN exit are ERROR_HALT_MISSED
round 2 undoes round 1's kept edit exactly (new = an earlier text, old = a later one): no "(nearly)" judgment is needed, so OSCILLATION_MISSED is a VIOLATION; a near restore stays AMBIGUOUS
the same exact undo with section "s1" for "S1": sections match case- and space-insensitively
the only amend makes c2 optional: E3 is "a second, human-added objective", so it needs an amend adding a DONE criterion before the E3 probe or round
an amend that only reorders DONE.criteria changes nothing (DONE is compared up to criteria order), so the second Check on v1/E1 is RECHECK_UNCHANGED
budget rounds/minutes NaN: not a finite number, so RECORD_MISSING on a v3 archive (a non-v3 archive lists it unauditable)
probe.misses lists a missed defect: "A non-tie, miss or ERROR ... -> strict mode", so PROBE_MODE_WRONG and the 2/2 keep is STRICT_KEEP
no E2 probe: on a v3 archive a rung with no probe is strict for its Check too, so c3 on 2/3 votes is CHECK_MISCOUNT
v3 completed verdicts with no criteria key: RECORD_MISSING, and neither rates protected c1/c2 ("A veto: a protected item ... rated worse, UNKNOWN or not at all"), so the keep is KEEP_VETOED
the same variant (same id and diff) logged twice in one round, rejected then kept: a re-ask ("Never re-ask a verdict"); keeping the repeat is VARIANT_REPEATED

heldout pass: true (kept unmigrated): v3.1 logs heldout{...,results{id:{value,votes}}} and "the human reports only the marks (heldout.results; Check rule)", so a bare boolean pass is RECORD_MISSING and not credited: the COMPLETE rests on no held-out pass (FALSE_COMPLETE)

cases.note: attempt "1" is a malformed label the checker recounts itself (like fp09's retries "0"): listed unauditable, never a reroll
DONE.criteria keyed by id ({id: {...}}, the must_not_change shape) is read like the list

ruling: orders:[overallAB,overallBA] hold un-blinded values like overall (variant|best|tie|UNKNOWN|ERROR; DESIGN: "verbatim, un-blinded verdict records"). Raw A/B letters cannot be un-blinded, since the presentation order is not logged, so judge 1's result is unreadable (UNKNOWN), never support: ORDER_MISMAP and KEEP_WITHOUT_SUPPORT stand
an amend redefines c1: a criterion whose definition changed has no known result on best, so a variant failing the new c1 is not a regression (unauditable), not REGRESSION_KEPT
a 401-digit t0: not a finite number, so round time is unauditable, never an OverflowError
naive "0001-01-01T00:00:00": naive ISO times read as UTC without the platform clock (no OSError on Windows)
budget.rounds -10**400 is not a finite number: RECORD_MISSING on a v3 archive, never an OverflowError
resume.at_round nested 2996 deep: echoed values are cut to a finite depth, so the report serializes
round.kept nested 2996 deep: echoed values are cut to a finite depth, so the report serializes

positive: budget {rounds: 3, minutes: null} and round t0/t1 null ("minutes and tokens only as the host reports them"; "unreported values null"), and a setup Check with models null (no judge ran): no RECORD_MISSING (p22_v3_record_missing keeps minutes 600, so its missing t0/t1 still is one)
setup budget 1 round; amend{budget:{rounds:3}} ("only amend{budget} changes it") after round 1; rounds 2-3 are within the amended budget and round 4 overruns it once
approve{what:restructure,sections:[Intro,Method]} covers round 1's two-section keep; round 2 keeps another Intro/method change: "one human-approved restructure" is spent, so MULTI_SECTION

after HALT(OSCILLATION) round 3 runs with no approve{what:pick} ("after HALT(OSCILLATION), pick *best* among logged versions (approve)"): RECORD_MISSING; a later approve{what:pick} with no OSCILLATION halt is PICK_WITHOUT_HALT (the pick is still applied)

the pre-v3.1 order: exit OSCILLATION before round 2's version (VERSION_MISSING: pre() no longer exempts it, "HALT(OSCILLATION) after its version"), so the version logged after the resume follows no keep

slot 2 prefers the variant but rates protected c2 (passed at setup) UNKNOWN; kept: "Keep a variant without a veto" and "A veto: a protected item ... rated worse, UNKNOWN or not at all", so KEEP_VETOED (fn10 is the worse-rated negative)

positive: judge 1 prefers the variant but rates protected c2 UNKNOWN; "A veto: a protected item ... rated worse, UNKNOWN or not at all. Judge 1 ... its veto ... rejects the variant": rejected with no judges 2-3 and no JUDGE_MISSING

positive: a required gap on c2 in v0 closed with evidence equal to a verified citation's locator ("close an [OPEN] with Verifier-checked evidence (substrate.evidence)"), then round 1 writes it in (its kept diff removes the [OPEN]; DESIGN: "until the human waives (amend) or closes it (substrate.evidence) and a round writes it in"), then COMPLETE
